name: Starting Over Again
overview: Starting over again is a profound act of God’s mercy and grace, as He promises to blot out our transgressions and not remember our sins, inviting us to prepare our hearts and reach out to Him. Scripture encourages believers to forget the former things and trust in the Lord’s perfecting work in their lives, assured that His plans are for peace and a hopeful future. Central to this renewal is the gospel of Christ, through whom eternal life is granted to all who believe, affirming that true restoration comes by faith in Jesus.
